model: Chinese Note type (Sentence card by Default)

fields.name: Expression
fields.description: Term expressed, without inflections (Chinese has none), using the maximal-character form actually seen in the sentence. Best field for search and duplicate detection.

fields.name: Definition
fields.description: Mined glossary HTML (Yomitan). Compacted to 1 dictionary / 2 senses on the card; the full version lives in Extended definition.

fields.name: Hanzi Notes
fields.description: Empty by default. Per-character information you deem necessary: radicals, stroke counts, mnemonics, component words, confusable pairs.

fields.name: Source
fields.description: URL, show name, book name, etc.

fields.name: Sentence
fields.description: The mined sentence. Must be self-contained enough to solve the card on its own (PRODUCT.md: front sentence = self-contained learning unit).

fields.name: Sentence Pinyin
fields.description: Pinyin of the Sentence, tone-marked or numeric. Shown as a quiet second line under the sentence on the back card.

fields.name: Translation
fields.description: English translation of the sentence; literal wording is welcome.

fields.name: context
fields.description: The whole paragraph/dialogue. Typically from books, added manually.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Everything else: grammar, other word definitions.

fields.name: Pinyin
fields.description: Tone-marked Pinyin of the Expression (e.g. chuáng). This is the reading the learner is testing; the template colors the four tones.

fields.name: cloze-body
fields.description: Original term as it appeared before Yomitan reduced it to dictionary form. Chinese is unaffected by inflection, so this equals Expression for most cards; it is the second identity discriminator for the Mature Word Mode content search.

fields.name: Frequency
fields.description: Frequency rank of the cloze body.

fields.name: Extended definition
fields.description: Full mined glossary. Shown only behind 详情.
